test_policy.notes: FHSU's international scholarship page states that an ACT/SAT score is not required to apply for admission as an international student; it is only needed to qualify for the Freshman Scholarship. Admission rests on a 2.5 GPA (4.0 scale) from the secondary transcript.

requirements.notes: Apply through the FHSU international application portal; the $50 fee is non-refundable and valid for 12 months. Required: passport ID page, official transcripts (English or with NACES word-for-word translation; first-year minimum 2.5/4.0), English proficiency, and the International Student Financial Data and I-20 Request Form with a certified bank statement covering one year (at least the current estimated expenses, $30,239 for 2026-27). Essays and recommendations are not listed. These are the on-campus (Hays) rules; online and partnership programs have different, later deadlines.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 on-campus international application deadline
deadlines.notes: Last day to submit a completed application including all admission documents. The page prints June 1 without a year; treated as 2027. Spring 2028 entry: Nov. 1 (the same page also prints Oct. 1 once). Summer is not permitted for on-campus international students.

deadlines.label: Last day FHSU issues I-20s for fall 2027 (on-campus)

english_policy.waiver_notes: Exceptions: 24 or more accredited US college credits with the admission GPA; English as the home country's native language; or current US high school enrollment with a 2.5 GPA and two years of English. Institutional TOEFL, TOEFL Essentials and institutional completion scores are not accepted. Applicants below the minimum can be admitted and sent an I-20 if they complete the online Intensive English Program of The Language Company (TLC) at Level 9. iTEP 3.6 is also accepted. The page gives no PTE or Cambridge minimum.

english.notes: No new 1-6 scale minimum is listed.

cost.notes: FHSU international undergraduate estimate (12 credits per semester): tuition and fees $15,624 ($651 per credit before the July 1 final rate, entered as one combined figure); McMindes Hall room and board $9,725; mandatory health insurance $3,000, miscellaneous $1,000, orientation/registration $150, housing contract fee $40 (together $4,190, entered as other); books $700; total $30,239. Figures are provisional until July.

aid.notes: FHSU World Ready International Scholarship: $1,000 per year ($500 per semester), awarded automatically to new first-time on-campus international students who stay at a 2.5 GPA (undergraduate). The Freshman Scholarship ($1,500-$3,750 per year, automatic, based on ACT/SAT and high school GPA) is open to first-time on-campus international students who submit scores. Stouffer and Solko & Olliff scholarships (amounts vary) need an application after admission. No international need-based aid is described.

sat.note: The international pages print no SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: The international pages print no ACT code; look it up at act.org.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code is printed; look it up in the ETS code search. Scores must come from the testing company directly to FHSU.

pte.note: PTE is not listed as an accepted test.
